focus_areas: Bone texture realism vs. plastic/smooth AI artifacts
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'solid bone' nature of the frill. AI often mistakenly adds holes (fenestration) characteristic of other ceratopsians. Verify if the lower jaw articulation looks physically plausible or if it suffers from 'melting' into the cranium. Ignore the missing body/limbs as they are out of frame, but penalize any anatomical impossibilities in the visible skull structure.

The subject is static and inanimate.

To verify that the skull is a single coherent object without floating fragments or erroneous holes in the solid frill structure.
To assess the overall realism of the lighting, shadows, and texture consistency between the fossil subject and the museum background.
